definitions: A free-floating perennial aquatic plant (Eichhornia crassipes) native to tropical South America, having showy lavender flowers and often forming dense mats that can obstruct waterways.
Any of several other aquatic plants of the genus Eichhornia.
examples: The pond was choked with water hyacinth.
Water hyacinth is known for its rapid growth.
They are trying to remove the water hyacinth from the lake.
